summary: Full end-to-end testing of Kıbrıs Night Club app — bilingual escort directory. Backend (7 pytest cases) and Frontend (35+ Playwright assertions including mobile menu) all passed. All listed features in review_request verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') — recommend migrating to FastAPI lifespan handler.
CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — combination is browser-rejected; tighten origins for production.
No rate limiting / spam protection on POST /api/contact — public form can be abused; consider captcha or basic rate-limiting.
Email field on ContactMessageCreate is Optional[str] with no EmailStr validation — invalid emails would be accepted.
GET /api/contact has no auth — exposes user-submitted PII (name/phone/message) publicly. Should require admin auth.
seed_data_creation: Test contact messages prefixed with 'TEST_' inserted into MongoDB contact_messages collection (3 docs). Not cleaned up automatically.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py covers /api/contact (POST/GET, validation, no _id leak) and /api/status. Frontend Playwright flow verifies: age modal, home page testids (hero, why-item-0..3, featured-view-all, cta-banner-wa, 6 featured profile cards), lang switch TR↔EN (title + meta + nav text update), gallery (12 cards + 4 filters reducing to 4 on 'new'), profile detail /galeri/elena with wa+call buttons, services 6 rows, pricing 3 cards with VIP middle 'En Popüler', FAQ 8 items expandable, blog 4 cards opening /blog/<slug>, contact form submit shows TR success toast 'Mesajınız başarıyla gönderildi', floating-whatsapp-btn linking to wa.me/905488552387, site-footer, mobile-menu-btn opens mobile-menu overlay at 390px viewport. WA href confirmed: https://wa.me/905488552387.
